description.value: Howard Johnson by Wyndham Downtown Kamloops is a mid-scale chain hotel located on Columbia Street in downtown Kamloops, a major hub on cycling routes through the interior of British Columbia. As part of the Wyndham Hotels group, it offers standard hotel services in a convenient downtown location within walking distance of the Thompson River. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops on the Trans Canada or other interior routes would find it a practical overnight option in the city centre.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms an active Wyndham Hotels listing for 'Howard Johnson by Wyndham Downtown Kamloops' at the OSM-provided URL, establishing the hotel as real and open. However, the fetched page content is almost entirely navigation boilerplate and booking-widget UI with no property-specific amenity details, so no cyclist amenities (bike storage, laundry, etc.) can be confirmed from the website. Wi-Fi is tagged in OSM as internet_access=wlan but the rules prohibit treating OSM amenity tags as authoritative without website corroboration, so it is left null.
concerns: Website content returned mostly navigation boilerplate with no property-specific amenity information; cyclist amenities cannot be verified.
OSM name is 'Howard Johnson' while official_name tag and website title both use 'Howard Johnson by Wyndham' — minor branding discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active chain hotel in downtown Kamloops confirmed by its Wyndham corporate listing. A practical overnight option for touring cyclists passing through the region.
